name: Tata Motors Ltd
title: Tata Motors Ltd - 544569 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 volumes up 25% and EBITDA margin 13.9%, but management flagged 100bps commodity hit in Q4, more in Q1, only a 2% price rise with partial pass-through, and no FY27 guidance beyond single-digit Q1 growth.

capex.quote: we expect FY27 also our guidance would remain similar, 2% to 4% of revenue

triggers.label: Commodity hit 100bps Q4, more in Q1
triggers.quote: we've already seen around 100 basis point impact in Q4. Beyond the impact in Q4, we have also seen significantly higher impact being seen in Q1

triggers.label: 2% price hike, not full pass-through
triggers.quote: we have taken a 2% price increase in the month of April, but we have decided to not pass on the entire commodity increases

triggers.label: Q4 wholesale volume +25% YoY
triggers.quote: Q4 wholesale reached close to 131.8K units, 25% year-on-year increase

triggers.label: Q1 growth only single-digit or more
triggers.quote: we should see a single -digit growth, if not more, in Q1

triggers.label: Tata Motors outpaced TIV: +25% vs +19%
triggers.quote: the offtake TIV grew 19% YoY in Q4 while Tata Motors volumes outpaced the industry at 25% YoY growth

guidance.quote: we should see a single -digit growth, if not more, in Q1
we expect FY27 also our guidance would remain similar, 2% to 4% of revenue
we expect this to kind of spill into Q2, and that's where our timeline for deal closure is going to be Q2

red_flags.label: Commodity cost squeeze into Q1 with partial pass-through
red_flags.quote: we have decided to not pass on the entire commodity increases

red_flags.label: Middle East shipments halted
red_flags.quote: we have had no shipments to Middle East in the last two months

evasions.topic: Mid-teens/teens EBITDA margin guidance under cost headwinds
evasions.quote: we will have to go really quarter by quarter
we will have to take quarter-by-quarter rather than projecting for the whole year
